    def parse(s):
        i = [0]
        def go():
            if i[0] >= len(s) or s[i[0]] == '-':
                if i[0] < len(s) and s[i[0]] == '-': i[0] += 1
                return None
            assert s[i[0]] == '('
            i[0] += 1
            j = i[0]
            while j < len(s) and s[j].isdigit(): j += 1
            val = int(s[i[0]:j]); i[0] = j
            L = go() if i[0] < len(s) and s[i[0]] == '(' else None
            R = go() if i[0] < len(s) and s[i[0]] == '(' else None
            assert s[i[0]] == ')'; i[0] += 1
            return TreeNode(val, L, R)
        return go()
